headline: Pinnacle Electronics reports record quarterly revenue
body: Pinnacle Electronics reported revenue growth of 5% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Pinnacle Electronics to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Pinnacle Electronics will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Penang. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Pinnacle Electronics signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Pinnacle Electronics announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.
